title.en: The checks a gateway applies to an OFFER before listing it

goal.en: A gateway must refuse to list offers that fail the cold-chain checks: chilled above 5 °C, frozen above -18 °C, hot-held below 60 °C, or a chilled-class food declared ambient. The parser returns the finding ids.

args.text: OFFER 18KG COOKED RICE TRAYS H T52C

note.en: Chicken declared ambient: the item words imply poultry, so safety.storage_class_mismatch.

args.text: OFFER 18KG COOKED RICE TRAYS H T66C

note.en: The same rice at 66 °C passes and may be listed.

cli: cookwala sms "OFFER 18KG COOKED RICE TRAYS H T66C"

outcome.en: You know the four block findings and that they fire before a document exists. Next: scenario 070 applies the full rule pack to a recorded offer.
